# Create Specification

Use this fallback skill to produce implementation-ready specifications.

## Procedure
1. Define problem, goals, and out-of-scope boundaries.
2. Capture functional and non-functional requirements.
3. Add acceptance criteria and validation strategy.
4. Generate a specification suitable for planning and delivery.
